items.html: And the matter is that ZA is called Adam, after the name MA of the filling with Alephs that is in it, as is known. And if you add to it the count of its simple letters, which are twenty-six, all together will be, in gematria, Aleph-Lamed-Mem. Behold, how Mi made the man mute, to indicate this. And the matter is that only the ilem of Elokim was revealed in him. Also, if you fill the two letters Mem-Hei: Mem-Mem, Hei-Aleph, they will be in gematria Elokim, as mentioned in Tikkun 31 and 38 of Etz Chaim, for from there come the three letters Aleph-Lamed-Mem mentioned.
